source: Consolidated from KRISHNA project conversations and verified repository decisions
non_negotiables: KRISHNA is the only public identity and final decision authority.
KRISHNA is standalone and independent; E:\KRISHNA-SOURCE is authoritative code and E:\Krishna-The GOD is runtime/state/models/assets.
Internal engines, specialists and adapters never replace KRISHNA authority.
Mutating, destructive, credential, external-message and other high-impact actions remain behind Policy/approval boundaries and audit.
An agent never self-declares success; evidence is checked by an independent verifier before promotion.
Unfinished commitments are never silently discarded; resume, explicitly supersede, cancel or complete them.
Runtime/UI must report observed state honestly; unavailable optional providers fail closed.
Final Krishna_AGI.exe is built only after Windows runtime, browser/UI, mobile, recovery and deployment-integrity acceptance.
KRISHNA Mobile never exposes raw shell, arbitrary filesystem access, credentials, or trading authority; sensitive actions remain behind device authorization and Core Policy.
Remote-away access is private-network-only; KRISHNA must not expose Core control APIs directly to the public Internet.
Protected and archive project roles are read-only to autonomous mutation and promotion.
Garuda is the research/evidence scout; Garudanetra is the browser/computer fabric. Neither replaces KRISHNA authority.
Every operational dashboard control must resolve to a real runtime contract; mutating priority controls use the Shared Action Bus and receive auditable action receipts.
Every delegated capability enters through Sudarshan's permissioned Action/Job architecture and leaves through the independent verifier; no framework gains authority by being powerful.

PC human navigation stays minimal: Main Menu exposes only KRISHNA, Sudarshan and Plugins; Projects are expandable folders with nested project chats and Rename/Delete/Share actions; global Chats stays separate with a New Chat control. Internal KRISHNA systems remain runtime capabilities rather than sidebar clutter.

groups.title: Autonomy and supervision
requirements: Observe registered projects and system state, detect errors, plan repairs, code bounded fixes, test, restart and verify.
Manage CPU/RAM pressure and avoid uncontrolled heavy workers.
Maintain active versus protected/archive project distinction and do not mutate backups as live projects.
Continue safe routine work without babysitting and surface meaningful verified completion notifications.
Crash loops use heartbeat/supervision, exponential restart backoff and quarantine instead of endless restart storms.
Critical RAM pressure may unload resident local models without deleting model files.

groups.title: Agent-native action/runtime foundation
requirements: Agent-Native is an architectural reference/foundation only; KRISHNA remains the product, public identity and final authority.
Integration order is Shared Action Bus -> Projects/Chats -> Agent Runtime -> Jobs -> Permissions -> Audit/Rollback -> MCP/A2A -> Dispatch -> Desktop/Mobile sync -> Garuda/Garudanetra.
Operational UI controls must be backed by real runtime behavior; priority mutating controls dispatch named Shared Actions and expose an action_id receipt.
Agents, jobs, MCP and A2A adapters do not call runtime internals directly; delegated execution resolves through explicit action manifests and capabilities.
Jobs reuse the durable TaskLedger instead of creating a competing job authority.
MCP/A2A are authenticated adapter boundaries over Shared Actions, not public unauthenticated control planes.
Desktop/mobile action state sync uses the existing authenticated realtime event store and does not turn KRISHNA Mobile into a dashboard or raw host-control client.
Project-code rollback remains under verified PromotionManager backups/post-checks; Shared Action rollback never weakens project promotion safeguards.

groups.title: BRAHMAGYAN deep knowledge and Rishi council
requirements: BRAHMAGYAN is KRISHNA's permanent deep-learning/research intelligence but never a second authority; all execution remains behind Sudarshan Action/Job permissions and independent verification.

Reading/search discovery is not learned knowledge. Claims mature sequentially L0 Discovered -> L1 Read -> L2 Understood -> L3 Source Verified -> L4 Cross-checked -> L5 Applied -> L6 Tested -> L7 Mastered -> L8 Connected.
Gautama performs evidence/epistemic review and Veda Vyasa compiles sufficiently cross-checked knowledge before trusted Gyan-Bhandar proposal.
Permanent Rishi/Acharya entries are lightweight role manifests, not permanent running model processes.
Modern scientific evidence and Vedic/classical knowledge remain separately labeled and are compared only after source-faithful understanding; similarities never establish scientific identity.
Contradicting evidence is retained with explicit resolution history; credible conflicts are never silently collapsed.
Temporal knowledge preserves previous/current state, validity, source history and supersession.
Trusted Gyan proposals retain traceable provenance whenever provenance is available.
Rishis may request temporary Shishya researchers through AI-HR/Sudarshan; v1 batches are capped at four and require approval for execution.
Before Shishya retirement, verified findings, methods, failures, corrections, evaluation, sources, provenance and useful cross-domain learning are preserved.
BRAHMAGYAN curiosity is priority/resource bounded and v1 starts no autonomous background-learning daemon.

groups.title: Sudarshan work console
requirements: GPT-style persistent project chats with file attachments and real Rename, Pin, Share, Move and Delete actions.
Active Work, Verification and System Load informer.
When browser work starts, transform into a Sudarshan/Garudanetra split workspace rather than opening a dead status page.
Support project, research, investigate, plugin and developer workflows while KRISHNA selects internal engines automatically.

groups.title: Garuda research scout
requirements: Garuda owns public research/discovery/evidence gathering; it does not own Chromium sessions or browser control.
Garuda hands sourced evidence to KRISHNA; KRISHNA decides whether Garudanetra should open or interact with a selected source.
Research results remain untrusted external evidence until KRISHNA/KABACH/Verifier gates accept their use.

groups.title: Garudanetra browser/computer fabric
requirements: One canonical Garudanetra Browser Fabric owns browser/computer capability; Playwright/Chromium is the canonical verified engine.
Observe rendered DOM and accessibility-style semantic element refs, screenshots/frames, console, network, tabs, downloads and visible text.
Prefer CDP screencast for live frames with bounded screenshot fallback; live browser UI stays collapsed unless opened or owner attention is required.
Live Work controls include Pause, Take Control, Continue, Stop, Expand, navigation, tabs, typing, keypress, click, drag, scroll and bounded runtime-file upload.
Browser modes are Private, Private + Task Memory, and explicitly approved Persistent Workspace with project-specific profiles only.
Credentials/cookies remain browser session state, not learned memory; recorded entered values are redacted unless explicitly marked reusable.
Selector failures recover deterministically first, then optional Browser Harness or configured vision recovery; external recovery output is untrusted candidate evidence.
Successful selector recoveries and recorded workflows compile into distinct Gyan-Bhandar skill candidates and require verification/benchmark before Stable promotion.
Recorded workflows support bounded replay; consequential click/fill/type/upload style replay requires explicit approval.

Optional browser-use, agent-browser, BrowserCode, OpenDevBrowser, Rustwright, Lucarne, Skyvern, rrweb, Promptwright and Cereon capabilities are adapters/providers only and never silently replace the canonical engine.
UI Guardian and Developer browser verification use the same Garudanetra fabric/inspector boundary rather than creating competing browser authorities.

groups.title: Gyan-Bhandar and learning
requirements: Unified working, episodic, semantic, graph, skill and evidence memory facade.
Preserve provenance, confidence, candidate/verified state and supersession.
Codebase-Memory-MCP supplies structural code intelligence; Graft may provide persistent memory behind Gyan-Bhandar, never as a competing brain.
Repeated verified workflows can compile into deterministic skills and pass Benchmark Lab before Stable promotion.

groups.title: NARAD automation and messaging
requirements: Native KRISHNA event/workflow control plane with Draft, Candidate, Sandbox, Verified, Stable and Rejected lifecycle.
Schedules, webhooks, project/system events, execution history, retries, recovery and dead letters.
n8n, Activepieces, MCP and generic webhook integrations remain provider adapters, not KRISHNA authority.
External communication and app integrations use credential references and Policy/HITL gates.
Provider adapters cover Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets and Google Calendar behind Policy approval.
Credentials may be environment references or Windows DPAPI-encrypted local secret references; plaintext is never returned by status APIs.
NARAD adopts n8n-style workflow patterns natively but does not embed the n8n runtime, editor, database, queue workers, credential store or unrestricted node catalog.
NARAD workflows compile to typed action/job DAG nodes with explicit dependencies, safe data references, bounded retries, durable history, dead letters and per-run checkpoints.
Workflow data mapping supports bounded ${input.*} and ${nodes.*} lookup only; arbitrary Python/JavaScript expression evaluation is prohibited.
External webhook/provider steps are side-effecting, remain approval-gated, and are retried only when explicitly marked retry-safe.
Checkpoint resume skips already completed and independently verified nodes.
External n8n may be called only as a bounded webhook adapter behind Sudarshan; it never becomes KRISHNA's scheduler or authority.

groups.title: Specialists and developer
requirements: Select bounded specialists on demand for architecture, backend, frontend, debugging, DevOps, security, testing, research, data, UI and documentation.
Flow: User -> KRISHNA -> Planner -> specialists -> Critic -> independent Verifier -> KRISHNA decision -> Action.
Autonomous Developer uses Git evidence, shadow/candidate workspace, tests, browser/API inspection and rollback/promotion.
OpenMontage belongs to the media/YouTube worker boundary, not KRISHNA Core reasoning.

groups.title: KABACH
requirements: Project defensive-security and boundary guardian under KRISHNA authority.
Inspect tool permissions, untrusted content and egress boundaries; defensive research may be delegated through Garudanetra.
Keep evidence/audit for protected project boundaries.

groups.title: KRISHNA Mobile
requirements: Conversation-only secure voice/text interface; no dashboard, health-panel, project-list or raw-shell UI.
Use the same KRISHNA Core conversation/task state as PC and notify after meaningful verified completed work.
Persist device identity/credential locally; sensitive actions use device authorization rather than voice alone.
Support file/photo attachment and Odia/English conversation.
Owner voice gate may filter wake/listen flow locally but is not strong biometric security.
Remote-away usage requires secure transport and must not expose raw host shell/filesystem APIs.
Phone image/file attachments can be passed into the same KRISHNA conversation; supported images use local multimodal reasoning and evidence linkage.
KRISHNA Mobile accepts only LAN/private-overlay Core targets and refuses public Internet control targets.
Mobile must never expose raw shell, arbitrary host filesystem, plaintext credential, or trading execution APIs.

groups.title: Voice and avatar
requirements: Jarvis-like Odia conversation with explicit microphone/listening state.
Wake word 'Krishna' and owner-only wake are desired; sensitive actions still require device authentication.
Child KRISHNA avatar with states Idle, Flute, Listening, Talking, Dhyan, Searching and Working.
Final avatar goal includes rigged body animation, facial animation and lip sync when a verified asset/provider is available.
Native local Odia voice target uses AI4Bharat IndicConformer-style STT and Indic-TTS-style workers behind provider boundaries.
Always-listening wake-word target uses a local custom 'Krishna' wake model; wake detection is activation, never authentication.

groups.title: Command Center UI
requirements: Dark navy/gold/teal polished Command Center; Liquid Glass, Bento and Spatial UI used selectively.
KRISHNA Home is distinct from Sudarshan and should feel like the real operating presence, not a validation lab.
Vrindavan-inspired real-world home reference remains a target while operational pages stay functional.
Long-term UI stack target: React/shadcn, Dockview, React Flow, xterm and React Three Fiber with a Stable/Candidate/Experimental/Rejected GUI registry.
Sudarshan stays compact and contextual while KRISHNA Home keeps the larger avatar/core presence; Project -> Chats hierarchy remains visually clear.
Garudanetra Live Work includes an Expand mode and contextual owner controls rather than permanent clutter.

groups.title: Local tools and models
requirements: Prefer free/local tools where practical; Ollama/local models are implementation details behind privacy-aware routing.
Codebase-Memory-MCP, Graft, selected Agency-Agents, n8n and OpenMontage are integrated through bounded adapters.
Cloud model/API fallbacks must honor project privacy and credential isolation.
Optional providers are never reported active merely because source code is cloned.
Free-only model gateway profiles use encrypted local credentials and must never silently fall through to paid providers.
Local multimodal vision remains local-only unless a future project policy explicitly permits another provider.

groups.title: KRISHNA Glass roadmap
requirements: After PC and mobile stability: camera/vision, audio, IMU/head tracking, gestures, optional wrist/ring input and AR display.
Local low-latency Neural Action Graph/reflex layer performs observe -> decide -> act -> verify under KRISHNA authority.
Shared session/control with PC/mobile; hardware selection favors open interfaces and reasonable cost.
WearableBridge records only verified device capabilities; vendor camera/display/gesture support is never claimed before hardware adapter testing.
Phase 1 wearable bridge is Bluetooth audio/microphone/speaker plus phone camera; vendor display/camera and gesture/IMU/wrist/ring remain capability-gated.

release_gates: Source/runtime integrity is SYNCED to a verified deployment manifest.
Windows compile/unit/contracts and real runtime smoke tests pass.
Sudarshan project/chat/attachment/action workflows pass.
Garudanetra real browser work, evidence and recovery paths pass.
NARAD create/promote/execute/history and external-action gates pass.
Gyan-Bhandar candidate -> approval -> verified recall passes.
KABACH boundaries and Policy gates pass.
Mobile pairing/resume/conversation/notification tests pass on device.
Voice/avatar unavailable providers fail honestly and configured providers pass runtime checks.
Restart/recovery/rollback and CPU/RAM governance pass before final EXE packaging.
Encrypted credential vault and free-only model routing contracts pass.
Attachment -> local vision -> conversation evidence path passes with unsupported providers failing honestly.
Private remote transport policy rejects public Internet clients.
Crash-loop quarantine and critical-memory model unload boundaries pass.
Garudanetra browser-mode lifecycle and owner-control actions pass.
Wearable vendor capabilities remain unverified until hardware evidence exists.
Garuda research and Garudanetra browser/computer responsibilities remain separate in runtime and UI.
Garudanetra semantic refs, browser-fabric status, frame transport, action recording and replay approval gate pass runtime acceptance.
Shared Action Bus, Agent Runtime, Jobs, Permissions, MCP/A2A adapter and Dispatch acceptance checks pass.
Priority operational UI controls produce real Shared Action receipts; decorative-but-unwired controls are release defects.
NARAD reports typed-dag/sudarshan mode with Sudarshan bound in runtime acceptance.
NARAD checkpoint/resume, bounded retry, safe data mapping and independent workflow verification tests pass.
No full n8n runtime process/dependency is required for KRISHNA Core.
BRAHMAGYAN L0-L8 maturity gates, Rishi council manifests, dual-track knowledge discipline and provenance contracts pass.
BRAHMAGYAN Shishya execution remains approval-gated, capped and temporary; no permanent research worker fleet is introduced.
Minimal sidebar contract passes: no internal runtime modules are exposed as Main Menu items; project delete preserves chats by moving them to global Chats.
